# A non-positive -generation refuses the invocation before any
# toolchain work starts: exit 2, the usage fault with its help pointer
# on stderr, nothing on stdout — there is not even a solution here to
# read.

status 2 sdl build -generation 0
! stdout .
cmp stderr want-stderr

-- want-stderr --
sdl: build: generation must be positive
Run 'sdl help build' for usage.
